issuer.seed_label: LibAngel reference issuer v1: GPT-5 Codex independent DropOfWater card
issuer.key_note: Private key derived from the public seed label; forgeable by design. The signature attests reproducibility, not issuer identity.

policy.normalization: Chunk vectors and final pooled vector are L2-normalized
policy.pooling: Producer-choice provisional reduction: token chunks of 480 body tokens; encode each chunk with normalize_embeddings=True; token-count weighted mean; final L2 normalize
policy.reduction_policy: producer-choice until the TACL pooling study pins a reduction
